text:
The total value of securities approved by security holders but not yet issued under Global Payments’ equity compensation plans as of May 31 2014 is **$31.32 million**.  

Calculation:  
- Number of securities remaining available for future issuance (approved by security holders) = 766,801 [D43_C0].  
- Weighted‑average exercise price = $40.85 [D43_C0].  
- Value = 766,801 × $40.85 = $31,323,361.85 ≈ $31.32 million.
